title: board.task_updated subscription arguments
description: A task was created, became ready, was claimed, renewed, released, blocked, completed, failed, canceled, reassigned or relabelled. Filter by channel, state or labels (board.task=<state> works too) to watch a work queue.

channel.description: A channel, or a path ending in '/' for that channel and every channel under it (www/ matches www, www/production and www/preview)
